title: LEAD PROGRAM ANALYST with Security Clearance

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Lead Program Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Weighs degree of urgency against schedules and funding to resolve conflicts between competitive requirements and resources.
Reviews policies, directives, regulations, orders, etc., received from higher echelons and assures their timely and consistent interpretation and implementation.
Translates cost and program estimate to objectives and budgets.
Coordinates and directs/develops financial and workload data, reviews unfinanced requirements and recommends the distribution of resources to ensure a balanced program.
Provides leadership and coordination to prepare and execute International Program funds within the PM STORM Financial Management Division.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes: 1) Identifying and consolidating mission requirements; 2) Creating, Managing, and finalizing the execution of various personnel actions from initial conception to execution; 3) Preparing documentation in support of budget processes; 4) Collaborating with external offices to support the organization in identifying and communicating requirements. This typically includes work performed at the next lower grade/level (NH-02/GS-11) position in the federal service.
For this job, you must meet the qualification requirement using experience alone — no substitution of education for experience is permitted.
You will be required to provide proof of U.S. Citizenship.
Direct deposit of pay is required.
Appointment may be subject to a suitability or fitness determination, as determined by a completed background investigation.
Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. You will be asked to identify which category or categories you meet, and to provide documents which prove you meet the category or categories you selected. See Proof of Eligibility for an extensive list of document requirements for all employment authorities.
Current Department of Army Civilian Employees
Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS) Interchange Agreement
Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan
Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act
Military Spouses, under Executive Order (E.O.) 13473
Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Reserve (MR) and National Guard (NG) Technician Eligible
Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Spouse Preference (MSP) Eligible
Priority Placement Program, DoD MR and NG Preference Eligible Tech Receiving Disability Retirement
Priority Placement Program, DoD Retained Grade Preference Eligible
Veterans Employment Opportunity Act (VEOA) of 1998
Preferred Requirements
Financial Management Level 2 certification within 24 months of entry on duty.
This is an Army Acquisition, Logistics and Technology Workforce position. Selectee must meet position requirements for Business - Financial Management Certification within 60 months of entrance on duty.
This position has a Temporary Duty (TDY) or business travel requirement of 25% of the time.
Incumbent is required to submit a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report, OGE-450, (5CFR Part 2634, Subpart I Confidential Financial Disclosure Reports) upon entering the position and annually thereafter.
You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas: Budget Administration, Leadership, Planning and Evaluating.
Male applicants born after December 31, 1959, must complete a Pre-Employment Certification Statement for Selective Service Registration.
A one-year probationary period may be required.
Selection is subject to restrictions resulting from Department of Defense referral system for displaced employees.
This is a General Administration and Management Career Field position.
Multiple positions may be filled from this announcement.

Weighs degree of urgency against schedules and funding to resolve conflicts between competitive requirements and resources.
Reviews policies, directives, regulations, orders, etc., received from higher echelons and assures their timely and consistent interpretation and implementation.
Translates cost and program estimate to objectives and budgets.
Coordinates and directs/develops financial and workload data, reviews unfinanced requirements and recommends the distribution of resources to ensure a balanced program.
Provides leadership and coordination to prepare and execute International Program funds within the PM STORM Financial Management Division.
cond_0239.requirements:
Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. You will be asked to identify which category or categories you meet, and to provide documents which prove you meet the category or categories you selected.
Current Department of Army Civilian Employees
Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS) Interchange Agreement
Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan
Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act
Military Spouses, under Executive Order (E.O.) 13473

Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Spouse Preference (MSP) Eligible
Priority Placement Program, DoD MR and NG Preference Eligible Tech Receiving Disability Retirement
Priority Placement Program, DoD Retained Grade Preference Eligible
Veterans Employment Opportunity Act (VEOA) of 1998
Minimum Requirements
Must obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Appointment may be subject to a suitability or fitness determination, as determined by a completed background investigation.
Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes: 1) Identifying and consolidating mission requirements; 2) Creating, managing, and finalizing the execution of various personnel actions from initial conception to execution; 3) Preparing documentation in support of budget processes; 4) Collaborating with external offices to support the organization in identifying and communicating requirements. This typically includes work performed at the next lower grade/level (NH-02/GS-11) position in the federal service.
For this job, you must meet the qualification requirement using experience alone — no substitution of education for experience is permitted.
Must provide proof of U.S. Citizenship.
Direct deposit of pay is required.
Male applicants born after December 31, 1959, must complete a Pre-Employment Certification Statement for Selective Service Registration.
This is an Army Acquisition, Logistics and Technology Workforce position. Selectee must meet position requirements for Business - Financial Management Certification within 60 months of entrance on duty.
Incumbent is required to submit a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report, OGE-450, upon entering the position and annually thereafter.
Preferred Requirements
Financial Management Level 2 certification within 24 months of entry on duty.
This position has a Temporary Duty (TDY) or business travel requirement of 25% of the time.
A one-year probationary period may be required.
You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas: Budget Administration, Leadership, Planning and Evaluating.
Selection is subject to restrictions resulting from Department of Defense referral system for displaced employees.

cond_0288.responsibilities:
Coordinate with stakeholders to weigh degree of urgency against schedules and funding, helping to resolve conflicts between competitive requirements and resources.
Review policies, directives, regulations, orders, etc., received from higher echelons and work with the team to ensure their timely and consistent interpretation and implementation.
Collaborate on translating cost and program estimates into objectives and budgets.
Coordinate and support the development of financial and workload data, review unfinanced requirements, and work with others to recommend the distribution of resources to ensure a balanced program.
Support and coordinate the preparation and execution of International Program funds within the PM STORM Financial Management Division.

Appointment may be subject to a suitability or fitness determination, as determined by a completed background investigation.
This position has a Temporary Duty (TDY) or business travel requirement of 25% of the time.

Financial Management Level 2 certification is required within 24 months of entry on duty.
Incumbent is required to submit a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report, OGE-450, (5CFR Part 2634, Subpart I Confidential Financial Disclosure Reports) upon entering the position and annually thereafter.

cond_0297.intro: We are looking for a Lead Program Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked].
cond_0297.responsibilities:
Works with stakeholders to weigh urgency against schedules and funding, helping resolve conflicts between competing requirements and resources.
Reviews policies, directives, regulations, and orders from higher echelons and coordinates their timely and consistent interpretation and implementation across the team.
Collaborates with relevant parties to translate cost and program estimates into objectives and budgets.
Coordinates with financial and program staff to develop workload data, review unfinanced requirements, and support the distribution of resources toward a balanced program.
Works alongside the PM STORM Financial Management Division to help prepare and execute International Program funds.
cond_0297.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
U.S. Citizenship required.
Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes: 1) Identifying and consolidating mission requirements; 2) Creating, managing, and finalizing the execution of various personnel actions from initial conception to execution; 3) Preparing documentation in support of budget processes; 4) Collaborating with external offices to support the organization in identifying and communicating requirements. This typically includes work performed at the next lower grade/level (NH-02/GS-11) position in the federal service.
Must meet one of the eligible employment authority categories (e.g., Current Department of Army Civilian Employees, VEOA, Military Spouses under E.O. 13473, Priority Placement Program eligibles, Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan, Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act, DCIPS Interchange Agreement, etc.). Proof of eligibility documentation is required.
Financial Management Level 2 certification required within 24 months of entry on duty.
Army Acquisition, Logistics and Technology Workforce position: selectee must meet Business - Financial Management Certification requirements within 60 months of entry on duty.
Required to submit a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report (OGE-450) upon entry and annually thereafter.
Qualification must be met using experience alone — no substitution of education for experience is permitted.
Direct deposit of pay required.
Male applicants born after December 31, 1959, must complete a Pre-Employment Certification Statement for Selective Service Registration.
Appointment may be subject to a suitability or fitness determination based on a completed background investigation.
A one-year probationary/trial period may be required.
Preferred Requirements
Business travel/TDY requirement of 25% of the time.
Demonstrated competency in Budget Administration, Leadership, and Planning and Evaluating.
Relevant performance appraisals and incentive awards noted in resume (may be considered during selection).
Familiarity with DoD referral and priority placement systems (PPP, ICTAP) is helpful for understanding the hiring process.

Weighs degree of urgency against schedules and funding to resolve conflicts between competitive requirements and resources.
Reviews policies, directives, regulations, orders, etc., received from higher echelons and assures their timely and consistent interpretation and implementation.
Translates cost and program estimate to objectives and budgets.
Coordinates and directs/develops financial and workload data, reviews unfinanced requirements and recommends the distribution of resources to ensure a balanced program.
Provides leadership and coordination to prepare and execute International Program funds within the PM STORM Financial Management Division.
cond_0454.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Must obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance.
Appointment may be subject to a suitability or fitness determination, as determined by a completed background investigation.
Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience which includes: 1) Identifying and consolidating mission requirements; 2) Creating, Managing, and finalizing the execution of various personnel actions from initial conception to execution; 3) Preparing documentation in support of budget processes; 4) Collaborating with external offices to support the organization in identifying and communicating requirements. This typically includes work performed at the next lower grade/level (NH-02/GS-11) position in the federal service.
For this job, you must meet the qualification requirement using experience alone — no substitution of education for experience is permitted.
Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. Current Department of Army Civilian Employees
Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS) Interchange Agreement
Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan
Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act

Financial Management Level 2 certification within 24 months of entry on duty.

cond_0471.requirements:

Around one year of specialized experience, including: 1) Identifying and consolidating mission requirements; 2) Creating, managing, and finalizing the execution of various personnel actions from initial conception to execution; 3) Preparing documentation in support of budget processes; 4) Collaborating with external offices to support the organization in identifying and communicating requirements. Male applicants born after December 31, 1959, must complete a Pre-Employment Certification Statement for Selective Service Registration.

Working knowledge of Financial Management practices; Financial Management Level 2 certification to be obtained within 24 months of entry on duty.
